1.w: And [on] His going forth out of the temple, one of His disciples says to Him, “Teacher, behold what stones and what buildings!”

2.w: And Jesus said to him,” “Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone here shall be left upon a stone that shall not be thrown down.”

3.w: And [in] His sitting at the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew were questioning Him by Himself,

4.w: “Tell us when these things will be, and what [is] the sign when all these things are about to be accomplished?”

5.w: And Jesus began to say to them, “Take heed, lest anyone may lead you⁺ astray.

6.w: Many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am [He],’ and they will lead many astray.

7.w: And when you⁺ shall hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. It is necessary to happen, but the end [is] not yet.

8.w: For nation will rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places; there will be famines. These [are] the beginning of birth pains.

9.w: But you⁺, take heed to yourselves. They will deliver you⁺ up to courts, and you⁺ will be beaten in synagogues, and you⁺ will stand before governors and kings on account of Me, for a testimony to them.

10.w: And to all the nations first it is necessary for the gospel to be proclaimed.

11.w: But when they might lead you⁺ away, delivering [you] up, do not be anxious beforehand what you⁺ shall speak; but whatever might be given to you⁺ in that hour, speak that. For you⁺ are not the ones speaking, but the Holy Spirit.

12.w: And brother will deliver up brother to death, and father, child; and children will rise up against parents and will put them to death.

13.w: And you⁺ will be hated by all because of My name; but the one having endured to the end, he will be saved.

14.w: But when you⁺ shall see the ‘abomination of the desolation’ standing where it should not (the one reading, let him understand), then those in Judea, let them flee to the mountains;

15.w: and the one upon the housetop, let him not come down nor go in to take up anything out of his house;

16.w: and the one in the field, let him not return to the things behind to take away his garment.

17.w: And woe to those having in womb and to those nursing in those days!

18.w: And pray that it might not be in winter,

19.w: for those days will be tribulation such as has not been from the beginning of creation that God created until now, and never shall be.

20.w: And if the Lord did not shorten the days, not any flesh would have been saved; but because of the chosen whom He chose, He shortened the days.

21.w: And then if anyone shall say to you⁺, ‘Behold, here [is] the Christ!’ [or] ‘Behold, there!’ do not believe [it].

22.w: For false Christs and false prophets will arise and will give signs and wonders in order to lead astray, if possible, the chosen.

23.w: But you⁺ take heed; I have forewarned you⁺ of all things.

24.w: But in those days, after that tribulation: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give her light;

25.w: and the stars will be falling out of the sky, and the powers that [are] in the heavens will be shaken.’

26.w: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

27.w: And then He will send the angels, and He will gather together His chosen from the four winds, from the end of earth to the end of heaven.

28.w: And from the fig tree, learn the parable: When its branch already shall have become tender, and it puts forth leaves, you⁺ know that summer is near.

29.w: So also you⁺, when you⁺ see these things coming to pass, know that He is near, at the doors.

30.w: Truly I say to you⁺ that this generation shall not have passed away until all these things shall have come to pass.

31.w: The heaven and the earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.

32.w: But concerning that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, except the Father.

33.w: Take heed; stay awake! For you⁺ do not know when the time is.

34.w: [It is] like a man going on a journey, having left his house and having given his servants authority, to each his work. And he commanded the doorkeeper that he should watch.

35.w: Therefore watch, for you⁺ do not know when the master of the house comes—either at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or morning—

36.w: lest, having come suddenly, he should find you⁺ sleeping.

37.w: And what I say to you⁺, I say to all: Watch!”
